en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a vast tropical waterfall complex, seen through silhouettes of tall palm trees and other vegetation in the foreground. Multiple broad curtains of water plunge over rocky cliffs into a mist‑filled gorge below. The scene appears lush and humid, suggesting a subtropical rainforest setting. There is a small printed numeric code in the lower right corner.
